India Demands Action from Pakistan Over Gurdwara Damage

India has expressed strong disapproval regarding reports of damage to a 125-year-old gurdwara in Pakistan. The Ministry of External Affairs condemned the incident, calling it a deliberate act of vandalism and urged Pakistan to take strict action against those responsible.
